From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

As Manager, Technical Enablement, you will be the founding people leader of a dedicated technical enablement function, built to support our large and growing global Sales Engineering team. Our Sales Engineers are central to how we win, and as the team scales, it needs enablement that matches the depth of the work. You will hire, lead, and develop a team of enablement professionals, and you will serve as a player-coach, contributing directly to the programs your team delivers.

Working in partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement and global Sales Engineering leadership, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of advanced technical enablement. You will identify capability gaps, establish proficiency standards, and build the technical onboarding, hands-on workshops, certifications, and ongoing coaching that take our field well beyond foundational product knowledge. You will partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to turn each release into field-ready technical content, and you will measure readiness and program effectiveness so that the function earns its place as a trusted partner to the field and to leadership.

Technologies You’ll Use

Notion, Salesforce, Gong, Thought Industries, Claude, Sumble, Hex, Nook, Jira, Navan, Nooks, Sales Navigator, AI role play tools

What You’ll Do

• Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of advanced technical enablement in partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement for the global Field Engineering team 

• Lead and develop a team of enablement professionals while serving as a player-coach, contributing directly to the execution of team priorities.

• Partner with global Field Engineering leadership to identify capability gaps, establish proficiency standards, and prioritize readiness programs across regions.

• Build and maintain deep technical product training, hands-on workshops, certifications, and ongoing coaching that go beyond foundational seller education.

• Define technical onboarding curriculum, ramp milestones, and proficiency benchmarks in partnership with the existing onboarding team.

• Partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to translate releases and product differentiation into field-ready technical content and practical exercises.

• Collaborate with Sales and Revenue Enablement to connect seller-facing technical fluency with advanced solution discovery, demonstrations, evaluations, and technical sales processes.

• Build a structured feedback loop between field teams and Product, and measure technical readiness, training adoption, demo environment health, and program effectiveness.

• Lead cross-functional programs through influence, clear stakeholder alignment, and disciplined execution in a global matrix environment.

• Monitor completion rates, assessment results, field feedback, and ramp outcomes, and use these insights to refine programs and report progress to leadership.

Skills We’re Looking For

• 4+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, field engineering, or related technical go-to-market roles, with demonstrated leadership of complex programs or teams.

• Previous people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing team members

• Deep working knowledge of modern data platforms, data integration, analytics engineering, cloud data architectures, and technical evaluation practices.

• Experience designing enablement programs, such as and delivering advanced technical training, coaching, and developing on-demand learning modules

• Ability to partner credibly with Product, Product Marketing, Sales, and senior Field Engineering leaders across a global organization.

• Strong program management, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder influence skills; ability to drive results through a matrix operating model.

• Ability to define measurable readiness outcomes and use field feedback to continuously improve programs.

Role: Associate Product Manager
Shift Timings: Indian working hours with limited overlap with initial US business hours 
Location: Bangalore, Hybrid 

RockED is a performance development platform built for the automotive industry. We partner with over 10,000 dealerships across the U.S., as well as major OEMs who use our platform to run and manage their own training programmes at scale. Our mobile-first app helps dealerships onboard new hires faster, develop stronger teams, and reduce turnover by delivering bite-sized training to sales reps, service advisors, and technicians right on their phones. 
The platform spans learning and performance management. On the learning side, it includes an AI Coach for personalised practice, gamified learning, and role-based certifications. On the performance management side, the platform surfaces real-world performance data for dealership staff, such as service advisors, and recommends targeted training based on that data to drive measurable improvement on the floor. We are headquartered in Florida, with our R&D team in India, backed by investors with strong roots in automotive and EdTech. 
We partner with 10000+ dealerships, empower 60,000+ learners, complete 15000+ certifications, and have crossed 11 million lesson completions

 Website https://www.rocked.us/
 App: apps.apple.com/us/app/the-rocked-app 

What You'll Actually Own

• The roadmap for learner experience, engagement, content delivery, and admin tools — not a list of features you're handed, but a point of view on what matters and why, one you can defend to leadership and to engineering.
• Direct lines to the people who use this every day — dealership managers, sales reps, service advisors, technicians. You talk to them regularly, because their world is the real spec.
• PRDs and user stories, tight enough that engineers just run with them — no epic back-and-forth, no "wait, what did you mean by this." Clarity is the job.
• A real seat at the design table — you should have opinions on the UX, and you should be comfortable telling design something feels off before it ships, not after.
• The connective tissue with our US team — launches, timelines, stakeholder updates. Some overlap with US hours comes with this territory.
• The metrics that prove, or disprove, your bets — you define what "working" means for your areas, and use it to decide what earns a place on the roadmap next.
• Growth and engagement plays — using tools like MoEngage and HubSpot to get the right nudge to the right person at the right moment.

How We Expect You to Work

• Build, don't maintain. Most of what you'll own doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing the first version of it. Experience driving Product-Market Fit (PMF) and business growth.
• Speak fluent engineering. You don't need to write code, but you need to understand trade-offs well enough that engineers don't have to over-explain themselves to you, and well enough that they trust your calls. Comfortable discussing system architecture, APIs, AI/ML capabilities, data models, and technical trade-offs.
• Use AI like it's already the default. We expect AI in the actual workflow — AI-assisted discovery, AI for first-draft docs and prioritisation, AI for turning raw customer feedback into patterns, AI for moving faster on the parts of the job that used to eat a whole afternoon
• Own outcomes, not tasks. Nobody here grades you on how many tickets moved to "done." You're graded on whether the thing you shipped actually changed a number that mattered. Data-driven mindset (A/B testing, metrics, experimentation)

Who Tends to Thrive Here

• You like problems that are still messy — nobody's handing you a clean spec
• You think in systems, not features — you can see how a change to onboarding ripples into retention three months later
• You're obsessed with what the customer actually needs, not what's easiest to build
• You use data and judgment together — you can read the output of a SQL query and still trust your gut when the data's incomplete. 
• You're curious enough to ask "why"
• You ship the 20% of a feature that carries 80% of the value — on purpose.
• EdTech or B2B SaaS background helps, but we care far more about how you think than the logo on your old business card

Why This, Why Now

We're growing over 100% year on year, backed by investors who've already built and exited multiple companies in this space. Our team spans the US and India, so you'll get exposure most Product Owners at this stage don't — to leadership, to investors, and to the real mechanics of scaling a platform used by frontline workers at 10,000+ dealerships.
We also run periodic in-person workcations, because some of the best product thinking happens away from a desk.
If owning a real slice of a fast-scaling platform — with the freedom to build it your way and the accountability that comes with it — sounds like exactly the kind of company you want to build with, we want to talk to you.

Ready to raise the bar?

Reach out to Kashish@rocked.us

About the Role

The Innovation Lab applies and adapts AI to accelerate work across eGov’s spectrum of products and platform — DIGIT and the products built on it, including DIGIT HCM (Health Campaign Management). The Lab runs a continuous pipeline of experiments, taking validated problems through bounded prototypes to capabilities that eGov’s product teams can adopt. It applies foundation models and modern GenAI techniques to gov tech problems rather than building models from scratch.
The AI Engineer is a hands-on builder in the Lab. Working closely with the AI Tech Lead, the engineer turns experiment ideas into working prototypes, runs evaluations, and helps build the reusable components and harnesses that keep the Lab fast — following sound engineering discipline throughout. This is an early-career role for a fast learner who is fluent with modern AI tools and eager to grow, with depth built through pairing, code review and bounded experiments across applied AI, engineering craft and the gov tech domain.

Key Responsibilities

• Build prototypes: Turn experiment briefs into working prototypes under the direction of the AI Tech Lead — using foundation models, LLM APIs, prompting, RAG and related techniques.
• Evaluation and evidence: Help design and run evaluations of prototypes for quality, reliability and latency, and capture results, limitations and observations clearly.
• Engineering quality and SDLC: Follow a disciplined development lifecycle — version control, code review, automated testing and continuous integration — writing clean, tested, documented and reproducible code.
• Reusable components: Contribute to shared components, evaluation harnesses and starter repositories that raise the Lab’s throughput.
• Handover-readiness: Produce clear technical notes and documentation so prototypes are transferable rather than black boxes.
• Communicate and collaborate: Pair with the Tech Lead and partner engineers, present at sprint showcases, and communicate progress, results and blockers clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Required Skills & Experience

1. Foundations: 0–2 years of experience; freshers welcome. Strong computer-science fundamentals — data structures, algorithms and clean coding practice. A degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent demonstrable ability.
2. Applied AI (core): Hands-on experience building with LLMs and modern AI tools — through work, internships, academic, hackathon or personal projects. Familiarity with prompting, LLM APIs and at least one AI/GenAI framework. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as part of everyday building.
3. Programming: Strong in at least one language, with Python preferred for AI work. Exposure to web or full-stack development; willingness to work across the DIGIT stack (Java, React, Flutter) is an advantage.
4. SDLC and engineering craft: Good grasp of the software development lifecycle — Git and collaborative development, code review, automated testing (unit and integration) and CI/CD basics — with care for documentation and reproducibility.
5. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain what was built and why, and to collaborate effectively within a small team.
6. Disposition: Fast learner; curious, resourceful, and able to work with minimal supervision. Interest in public sector, development sector, global health or govtech is a plus.

Good to have
• Experience with RAG, vector stores or agentic patterns; evaluation of AI systems; cloud (AWS/Azure) and Docker; contributions to open-source projects.

Location: Bangalore
Reports to: AI Tech Lead — Innovation Lab
Department: AI & Innovation Lab
Experience: 0–2 years (freshers welcome)
